module_summary: 32-bit carry-lookahead adder built from two 16-bit CLA blocks, with the upper block's carry-in and the final carry-out computed from the blocks' group generate/propagate signals.

anchors.name: A
anchors.why: 32-bit operand A, split into low and high halves for the two CLA blocks.

anchors.name: B
anchors.why: 32-bit operand B, split into low and high halves for the two CLA blocks.

anchors.name: S
anchors.why: 32-bit sum assembled from the two CLA_16 sum outputs.

anchors.name: C32
anchors.why: Carry-out computed from upper block group generate/propagate and c16.

anchors.name: c16
anchors.why: Inter-block carry from lower CLA group signals into upper CLA carry-in.

anchors.name: gx1
anchors.why: Lower block group generate, determines c16.

anchors.name: gx2
anchors.why: Upper block group generate, determines C32 with px2 and c16.

groups.name: cla_blocks
groups.description: Two 16-bit CLA adders computing low and high sum halves and group P/G.

groups.name: block_carry_lookahead
groups.description: Top-level lookahead logic combining group P/G into c16 and carry-out C32.
